notes: Ghost Mode now includes a movable, resizable companion comms panel with crisp full retained-turn messages and live Crew voice presence indicators.
Crew, Memory, Library, Settings, channels, profiles, tags, buttons, layouts, and responsive scaling received a comprehensive visual and usability upgrade.
All five HD companions support sharper 25-200% scaling, persistent placement, improved dragging, and restored navigation state.
Hosted companion voices and authenticated small-room Crew voice are included for the Windows alpha; Crew voice remains an HTTP/PCM alpha rather than WebRTC or end-to-end encrypted calling.
Performance, packaging, updater safety, shutdown, voice relay correctness, and recovery paths were audited and validated before publication.
